description: Clara Cosmic is a solo team focused on the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge. Combining a background in aerospace engineering, satellites, astrophysics, and scientific communication, this team transforms real NASA lunar and Martian mission data into an engaging educational storytelling experience. Our roster is currently complete.
summary: Voices of the Silent Explorers is an interactive educational storytelling project by Team Clara Cosmic that gives a first-person voice to NASA's retired equipment on the Moon and Mars. Using real telemetry and archival data, it transforms historical space hardware into engaging science lessons for students.
details: Many iconic NASA rovers, landers, and instruments remain on the Moon and Mars long after their primary missions end. Voices of the Silent Explorers bridges the gap between complex aerospace engineering and public science education through first-person mission logs. Featuring the Apollo 11 Lunar Laser Ranging Retroreflector, the Opportunity rover, and the InSight lander, each story translates real orbital imagery, seismic recordings, and solar power endurance into accessible narratives for young learners.
